title.tr: Yan tarafı tahta kaplı çaprazlı merdiven
title.en: Cross-braced stairs with a boarded side

alt.tr: Çaprazlı korkuluklu merdiven; yan tarafı tahtayla kaplı, ayakları toprağa gömülü, arkada tel çit
alt.en: Stairs with a cross-braced railing and the side clad in boards, legs set into the soil, with wire fencing behind

caption.tr: Merdivenin yanı baştan sona tahtayla kaplanmış. Kalın ayaklar toprağa oturuyor.
caption.en: The side of the stairs is boarded in from end to end. Thick legs are set into the soil.
